text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

For once, Mejiro Ramonu had gone for a run 
outside the academy instead of on the 
school grounds.

"Holding an extraordinary passion for 
racing, she normally prefers running on 
well-maintained tracks, but—"

The academy's turf track was temporarily 
out of commission due to resodding work. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...— The footsteps are scattered way too 
chaotically.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The turf is the only place where I can 
truly whisper sweet nothings in comfort...

Her expression didn't brighten. It seemed 
she wasn't able to get that exhilarating 
feeling like she does when running on the 
turf.

"Hoping to lift our spirits even a little, 
I decided to take a break in the 
cafeteria."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, Lord of Bewitchment? 
Have you grown somewhat weary from the 
battle against the giants?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If it is the Goddess's will, I shall 
become both the shield to protect her and 
the owl to aid her.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I am grateful for your 
actions. And—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So it is my turn from here, Goddess? Very 
well, allow me to display my skills to the 
fullest.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... It is finished—the ultimate 
cup! Taste and savor it with all your 
senses!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A cup lavishly loaded with spices!! An 
intensity fierce enough to awaken even a 
dragon slumbering in ice! You won't be 
able to resist squirming—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—!? It had no effect... you're kidding 
me...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's precisely what makes you 
the Devilish One. Very well. Next!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A cup brimming with freshly squeezed lime 
juice!! Sour enough to make even giants 
scream in agony!! Maintaining silence is 
utterly impossible—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!?!? Is it really... having no 
effect...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
............ I wonder if I'll be able to 
stand on the turf tomorrow.

The next day. The sky was a clear blue, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! This sensation wrapping around my 
legs...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I've been wanting to see you for so long— 
Fufufu...!"

Mejiro Ramonu gallops across the newly 
re-turfed track. A singular, devoted 
emotion radiates from her expression. Yes, 
almost as if—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: An innocent maiden... in love, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Our utter defeat... What sheer devilry. 
No, but still—that's so very like you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, you were here after all. Both of you.
choice_data_list: Glad to see you're feeling better!
Tanino Gimlet worked hard too, after all.
Tanino Gimlet worked hard too, after all.

text_block_list.text: Oh, you were here after all. Both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Right now, nothing stands between the turf 
and me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To whisper love to my heart's content, to 
be cherished―― ...Then there could be 
nothing better.

Her expression was completely unclouded. 
Once again, I found myself hoping from the 
bottom of my heart that she would continue 
to stand on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right. I prefer it to be a 
bit less sweet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho...! So I managed to leave an imprint on 
your heart...! Heh-heh, what an honor!

Even if only slightly, it seemed Tanino 
Gimlet's actions had a positive effect on 
Mejiro Ramonu.
